_comment: Titles for maps the game's map master leaves untitled (map.txt map_title None, floor 0), by map id; resolved by src/core/field/map_names.cpp override_title. A string is a message key of the game's own text. An object is a label inferred from the map's baked contents under the user's rules of 2026-10-11 (a named NPC's house, a generic NPC's House, else the event or key item the room holds, else nothing): {"text": mod text key}, {"owner": baked NPC name} = N's House, {"room": baked NPC name} = N's Room, {"item": item message} = I Room; a list joins its parts. Evidence per entry is in docs/MAP_LABELS.md. FF2's late-game Altair rebel hideout rooms (map_20131_6 to _10) carry no title, so the mod said plain 'Altair' there (user, 2026-10-10); MSG_MAP_NAME_11 = 'Rebel Hideout', the early rooms' title.
